description: Move up to 200 websites into a folder, or out of any folder. Name the folder with folder_id or folder (its name, ignoring case; both from list_folders). A folder that does not exist is an error, unless create_if_missing is true and folder is a name, which creates it first. Pass unfile: true instead of a folder to clear the websites' folder. Websites that cannot be moved (unknown id, archived, or registered by another member) are listed per id in rejected, and nothing moves in that case.

create_if_missing.description: Create the folder named by `folder` when none exists. Default false.

folder.description: Target folder name, an alternative to folder_id.

unfile.description: Clear the websites' folder instead of moving them into one.

name: move_websites_to_folder
title: Move websites to a folder
